translation: The eight vessels, scattered throughout the various books, are treated briefly and in no wise exhaustively. If a physician does not know these, he cannot probe into the mechanism of disease; if a Daoist [who cultivates immortality] does not know these, he cannot secure his furnace and tripod. Shizhen, being not clever, has consulted the various explanations and gathered them together below, to serve as the trap and snare (quanti) for those who study immortality and medicine [alike].
